seo.title: Cases: ReCover, TUA Apeldoorn, Qumey, EARTH | McCate
seo.description: Selected work: a circular model for medical face masks, expansion concepts for a university canteen in Apeldoorn, a circular product concept and interim management for a soil and archaeology firm.

title: Cases
sub: From a hard ambition to a concrete concept or a calmer operation. A selection of recent work.

cases.title: ReCover
cases.summary: Circular design and business model for medical face masks.
cases.client: DSM N.V., with iLINQ and Dijkgraaf Strategisch Advies
cases.challenge: In 2020 the region depended on overseas suppliers for protective equipment, and locally made masks were designed for incineration, destroying large volumes of high-value, non-renewable materials. Speed had come before sustainability.
cases.approach: Together with Dutch PPE Solutions (a joint venture of VDL and DSM), Maasstad hospital, Renewi and PreZero we mapped a circular value chain. Interviews, brainstorms and co-creation with hospital staff tested the legal, medical, design and material criteria and defined roles for a pilot.
cases.result: A complete concept design for the product and value chain, a feasibility assessment with a visual pilot roadmap, tested strategies for design and recycling, and an action plan for commercialisation. The work became the basis for a Dutch government procurement project.

cases.title: University canteen
cases.summary: Three concepts to expand a canteen on a tight site, taken to the municipality and the neighbours.
cases.challenge: The university canteen needed to grow, but the site left little room: among other things a protected tree could not be touched. Standard solutions did not fit.
cases.approach: We searched for the options the site did allow and developed three different concepts. We presented them to the municipality, supported the first steps towards a permit and presented the plans to the neighbourhood.
cases.result: A positive reception from the municipality and the neighbours. The university is now raising funds to realise the plan.

cases.title: Qumey
cases.summary: Conceptual design for a new circular product range.
cases.imageAlt: 3D artist impression of Qumey's circular product range
cases.challenge: Qumey wanted to show stakeholders and the industry what its new circular product range could be.
cases.approach: We defined and prioritised the key design criteria with Qumey, made a first digital concept and refined design and story in online feedback sessions.
cases.result: One conceptual image that shows the different designs, the sustainability story and the unique features, and helps Qumey communicate its product vision.

cases.title: Interim management
cases.summary: Keeping a soil investigation and archaeology firm running, then making it run better.
cases.client: Soil investigation and archaeology firm, Amersfoort (ongoing)
cases.challenge: After seven years the manager left. The organisation had to keep running while nobody yet knew where its processes were fragile.
cases.approach: Stepped in to keep operations going, then brought structure to the processes. First exposed the bottlenecks, now automating the repetitive work wherever possible.
cases.result: Continuity through the handover, clearer processes and less manual work, with the next improvements already in progress.
